guidelines: Use when content groups naturally into collapsible sections and hiding some of it is fine.
Keep headers short: enough to decide whether to expand.
Do not hide content people must compare side by side.

specs.variants: Standard, displaced, ghost, gradient, AI; single vs multiple expand
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg; full width by default
specs.notes: Renders as button headers with chevron; expands with productive motion.

a11y: Keyboard: Tab to header, Enter or Space toggles.
Keep aria-expanded in sync; focus must stay on the header.

guidelines: Use on content generated or assisted by AI so provenance is never hidden.
Keep AI framing obvious but quiet; it explains, it does not market.
Give people an undo or edit path next to generated content.

specs.variants: Inline, standalone, card; sizes mini, md
specs.sizes: ai sizes follow host control
specs.notes: Uses the blue AI gradient tokens; renders the AI label mark.

a11y: Always include a text equivalent for the AI mark.
Explainability content must be reachable by keyboard.

guidelines: Use for hierarchical location three or more levels deep.
Truncate middle crumbs on narrow views, never the current page.
Do not use as primary navigation.

specs.variants: Default, no trailing slash; AI variant
specs.sizes: Micro typography; separator is a chevron
specs.notes: Current page is plain text, not a link.

a11y: Wrap in nav with aria-label breadcrumb.
Mark the current page with aria-current=page.

guidelines: One primary action per view. Secondary actions stay secondary.
Labels are verbs that say what happens: Save, Delete, Create.
Icon-only buttons only for familiar actions.

specs.variants: Primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, danger (primary, ghost, tertiary)
specs.sizes: 2xl, xl, lg, md, sm, xs; fluid variant spans container
specs.notes: Default size lg (48px). Corner radius 0 by default.

a11y: Real button elements, focus ring visible at all sizes.
Icon-only requires accessible label (aria-label or tooltip).

guidelines: Independent choices: any number can be checked.
Write labels positively (Receive updates), avoid double negatives.
Group related checkboxes under a clear group label.

specs.variants: Default, indented, disabled, read-only; mixed (indeterminate) state
specs.sizes: 24px box; label also clickable
specs.notes: Group label uses FormGroup legend text.

a11y: Native input semantics; Space toggles.
Mixed state exposes as indeterminate, not checked.

guidelines: Use for short code people copy, not long reading.
Single line for commands, multi-line for blocks.
Truncate long output with show more, never silently.

specs.variants: Single, multi, inline; light background option
specs.sizes: Width follows container; copy button top right
specs.notes: Mono font; up to expand/collapse at 15 lines by default.

a11y: Copy feedback announced (Copied to clipboard).
Keyboard access to expand and copy.

guidelines: Use for read-only collections inside cards or panels.
Keep items scannable: primary text plus optional meta.
Do not use for full datasets; that is DataTable.

specs.variants: Default, with dividers, iconable items, searchable
specs.sizes: Full container width; row height follows content
specs.notes: Header can carry label, description, and search.

a11y: List semantics preserved; interactive rows are real buttons or links.
Search field labelled, results count announced.

guidelines: Use for two or three mutually exclusive views of the same content.
Labels must be one or two words and parallel.
Never for navigation between pages.

specs.variants: Default, low contrast; selected state filled
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg, xl
specs.notes: Switches content in place without page load.

a11y: Arrow keys move selection between switches.
Selected switch exposed as pressed or selected state.

guidelines: Use for structured data people scan, sort, or act on.
Keep columns purposeful; every column earns its width.
Provide pagination or virtual scroll for long datasets.

specs.variants: Basic, sortable, expandable, selectable, toolbar, batch actions, AI variants
specs.sizes: xs, sm, md, lg (default), xl row heights
specs.notes: Sticky header, zebra rows, and density are options.

a11y: Native table semantics; sort state exposed on headers.
Row selection announced; batch actions keep focus managed.

guidelines: Use when a real calendar helps; typing should always work too.
Label the format; never make people guess dd or mm first.
For ranges, keep start and end visibly paired.

specs.variants: Single, range, simple; fluid variants
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg input heights
specs.notes: Calendar popover follows Carbon date tokens; locale aware.

a11y: Calendar grid navigable by keyboard with arrow keys.
Invalid dates flagged in text, not color alone.

guidelines: Use when there are more than five options or space is tight.
Keep the list ordered predictably: alphabetical by default.
The label shows the current value; the title says what it is.

specs.variants: Default, multi-select, inline menu; fluid variants
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg heights; menu max height scrolls
specs.notes: Selected item shows checkmark in menu.

a11y: Arrow keys navigate; Escape closes and returns focus.
Listbox semantics with aria-activedescendant.

guidelines: Say what types and sizes are accepted before upload starts.
Show per-file progress and errors; never fail silently.
Allow removing a file before submit.

specs.variants: Button, drop container, drop zone; with filenames list
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg button sizes
specs.notes: States: uploading, complete, edit, error.

a11y: Errors described in text per file, linked to the file name.
Keyboard equivalent for drag and drop.

guidelines: One column, one question per row. Labels above fields.
Validate on blur and submit; errors list the fix.
Do not disable submit to hide validation.

specs.variants: Default, two-column at lg, fluid forms fill container
specs.sizes: Field spacing follows spacing-05 stack
specs.notes: FormGroup adds legend and description to field groups.

a11y: Every field labelled programmatically, errors aria-describedby.
Error summary links move focus to each field.

guidelines: Use for small inline status next to the action that caused it.
Pair with text: people should know what is happening.
Reserve full-page loads for full-page waits.

specs.variants: Active, inactive, finished, error states
specs.sizes: Small spinner 16px; text follows body copy
specs.notes: Success and error are icons with optional description.

a11y: Status announced with aria-live where timing allows.
Never rely on spinner motion alone as the signal.

guidelines: Link text says where it goes; avoid Click here.
Use links to navigate, buttons to act.
External links should be predictable, never a surprise download.

specs.variants: Default, standalone, express; visited state optional
specs.sizes: Inherits body size; standalone adds hover underline
specs.notes: Interactive color; visited purple is off by default in products.

a11y: Focus ring visible; target size meets minimum.
Underline on hover states must not be color-only.

guidelines: Use ordered lists for sequence, unordered for grouping.
Keep items parallel in grammar and similar in length.
Avoid nesting deeper than two levels.

specs.variants: Ordered, unordered, nested, expressive
specs.sizes: Body typography; indent follows spacing tokens
specs.notes: Native ul/ol markup preserved.

a11y: Real list elements so count and position are announced.
Do not fake lists with line breaks.

guidelines: Use when a block of content, not the whole page, is loading.
Keep waits honest: no fake progress claims.
Pair with text for waits longer than a second.

specs.variants: Small inline, page overlay, with description
specs.sizes: Small (32px) and default spinners; overlay darkens backdrop
specs.notes: Productive dash animation; respects reduced motion.

a11y: Container sets aria-busy while loading.
Reduced-motion users get a static indicator.

guidelines: Use for action lists triggered by a button, icon, or right-click.
Group related actions; dividers carry meaning.
Destructive actions go last and look dangerous.

specs.variants: Default, context menu, overflow menu; sizes sm, md, lg, xl
specs.sizes: Item height follows size; flip fits viewport
specs.notes: MenuButton composes button plus menu.

a11y: Menu and menuitem roles; arrows navigate, Escape closes.
Focus returns to the trigger on close.

guidelines: Use when a primary action has siblings, like Save and Save as.
Keep the primary action obvious; the menu is secondary.
Overflow menus are for excess actions on a row, not primary flows.

specs.variants: MenuButton, ComboButton, OverflowMenu
specs.sizes: Matches Button sizes where applicable
specs.notes: ComboButton splits primary click from menu trigger.

a11y: Trigger exposes aria-haspopup and expanded state.
Menu items reachable by keyboard in visual order.

guidelines: Use sparingly: one focused decision or interruption.
Passive for information, transactional for a task that ends with buttons.
Never stack modals. Never hide the only way out.

specs.variants: Passive, transactional, danger, AI; full-width, container bottom
specs.sizes: xs, sm, md, lg widths; content scrolls inside
specs.notes: Overlay dims backdrop; focus trapped while open.

a11y: Focus moves in on open and returns on close.
Escape closes; heading announced via aria-labelledby.

guidelines: Toast for transient info. Inline for status in place. Callout in forms.
One clear message. Action optional and honest.
Never the only record of something important.

specs.variants: Inline, toast, callout, actionable; success, info, warning, error
specs.sizes: Inline follows container; toast max width with timer option
specs.notes: Toast auto-dismiss defaults to no timer for critical messages.

a11y: Role status or alert by severity; errors use alert.
Close button labelled; timer pauses on hover or focus.

guidelines: Use for numbers people know exactly, like quantity 3.
Scrubbers for small adjustments; typing always allowed.
Say the unit and range next to the field.

specs.variants: Default, with steppers, no steppers, fluid
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg heights
specs.notes: Min, max, step configurable; invalid state in red text.

a11y: Up and down arrows step when focused on the buttons or input.
Out-of-range errors in text, not color alone.

guidelines: Use for long result sets; prefer load more for feeds.
Show total when known; page size choices stay few.
Keep the current page obvious and selectable.

specs.variants: Pagination with page sizes; PaginationNav without
specs.sizes: sm (table), md, lg heights
specs.notes: Prev/next plus numeric pages; ellipsis for gaps.

a11y: Nav landmark labelled; current page aria-current.
Changing page moves focus to results heading.

guidelines: Use for small contextual content tied to a trigger.
Dismiss on outside click; never trap people inside.
Keep content short; it is a peek, not a page.

specs.variants: Default, high contrast, caret; placements all sides
specs.sizes: Width fits content up to max; offset from trigger
specs.notes: Open state controlled or uncontrolled.

a11y: Trigger toggles with aria-expanded; Escape closes.
Focusable content reachable in DOM order.

guidelines: Use for determinate progress with a known total.
Label what is progressing; percent optional but honest.
Indeterminate only for truly unknown durations.

specs.variants: Determinate, indeterminate; success and error states
specs.sizes: Bar height 6px; full container width
specs.notes: Value 0 to max; helper text below.

a11y: Progressbar role with value, min, max.
State changes announced for long-running tasks.

guidelines: Use for multi-step tasks with a known order.
Current step unmistakable; completed steps revisitable.
Do not promise steps the flow cannot keep.

specs.variants: Horizontal (default), vertical; interactive steps optional
specs.sizes: Step circles with labels; spacing follows tokens
specs.notes: States: complete, current, incomplete, invalid.

a11y: Ordered list semantics; current step uses aria-current=step.
Invalid steps described in text.

guidelines: Exactly one choice from two to five options.
Default a sensible choice whenever possible.
Stack vertically; horizontal only for very short labels.

specs.variants: Default, disabled, read-only; tile variant
specs.sizes: 20px circle; label clickable
specs.notes: Group label via RadioButtonGroup legend.

a11y: Native group with radiogroup role and roving tabindex.
Arrow keys move selection within the group.

guidelines: Use when people know what they are looking for by name.
Search scope must be obvious; placeholder hints the scope.
Empty results explain the miss and offer next steps.

specs.variants: Default, expandable, fluid; with scope selector
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg heights
specs.notes: Clear button appears with text.

a11y: Search role with labelled input; clear button labelled.
Result counts announced via live region in products.

guidelines: Use the native picker for long lists and platform familiarity.
Choose a default that is safe and honest.
Use Dropdown instead for rich item content.

specs.variants: Default, grouped items, invalid state; fluid
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg heights
specs.notes: Chevron indicates the native menu.

a11y: Native select semantics; label always associated.
Grouped options use optgroup labels.

guidelines: Use for imprecise choice where the range matters more than the number.
Always show the current value next to the slider.
Pair with a number input when exactness matters.

specs.variants: Single, range (two thumbs), with text input
specs.sizes: Track full width; step configurable
specs.notes: Min, max, step; ticks optional.

a11y: Slider role with value text; arrows adjust by step.
Shift plus arrow for larger jumps.

guidelines: Use for key-value rows people compare line by line.
Keep headers short; rows stay on one baseline.
Use DataTable when sorting or row actions are needed.

specs.variants: Default, selectable rows, condensed
specs.sizes: Up to four columns; row padding follows tokens
specs.notes: Selectable adds radio behavior to rows.

a11y: List and row semantics preserved.
Selectable rows expose selected state.

guidelines: Use for same-page views of related content at one level.
Labels one or two words; order by importance.
Never nest tabs inside tabs.

specs.variants: Line, contained, icon; scrollable overflow
specs.sizes: Default height 40px; panels attach below
specs.notes: Selected tab underlines in interactive color.

a11y: Tablist roles; arrows move, Tab enters the panel.
Panels labelled by their tab.

guidelines: Use to categorize, filter, or show status briefly.
Text is one or two words; never a sentence.
Dismissible only when removal is a real action.

specs.variants: Read-only, dismissible, selectable, operational; 10+ colors
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg
specs.notes: Overflow collapses extras into a count tag.

a11y: Dismissible tags are real buttons with labels.
Meaning never carried by color alone.

guidelines: Use for short free text on one line.
Placeholder is an example, never the label.
Validate format inline with a fix-it message.

specs.variants: Text, password, fluid, read-only; with counter
specs.sizes: sm, md (default), lg heights
specs.notes: Helper text below; invalid state in red.

a11y: Label associated; helper and error via aria-describedby.
Password visibility toggle is a labelled button.

guidelines: Use to group related content in a scannable block.
Clickable tiles act as one action; selected state is explicit.
Do not nest interactive controls inside a clickable tile.

specs.variants: Default, clickable, selectable, expandable, radio tile
specs.sizes: Width follows grid; min height keeps targets tappable
specs.notes: Expandable reveals content below with chevron.

a11y: Whole-tile click keeps one tab stop on the tile itself.
Selected exposed via aria-pressed or checked state.

guidelines: Use for on/off settings that take effect immediately.
Label the thing being toggled, never just On or Off.
Use a checkbox when the choice applies on submit.

specs.variants: Default, small, disabled, read-only; AI variant
specs.sizes: 48px track default; small is 40px
specs.notes: State text optional (On/Off beside track).

a11y: Switch role with checked state.
Space toggles; focus ring on the track.

guidelines: Use to define a term inline without leaving the page.
Content is a sentence or two, focusable and dismissible.
Not for critical instructions; those stay visible.

specs.variants: Default, high contrast; placements all sides
specs.sizes: Trigger is inline icon or text with dotted underline
specs.notes: Opens on click, closes on Escape or outside click.

a11y: Trigger is a button with aria-expanded.
Content focusable; Escape returns focus.

guidelines: Use for tiny clarifications: icon names, truncated text.
Never hide essential instructions in a tooltip.
Keep it to a short phrase.

specs.variants: Default, icon-only trigger; placements all sides with delay
specs.sizes: Max width caps long labels; delay 100ms show
specs.notes: Hover and focus both reveal; touch shows on tap.

a11y: Trigger focusable; tooltip uses tooltip role.
Content never the only way to learn a control name.

guidelines: Use for nested hierarchies like files and folders.
Keep depth shallow; deep trees need search too.
Icons help scanning but labels carry meaning.

specs.variants: Default, with icons, multi-select, checkbox
specs.sizes: Row height follows size sm or default
specs.notes: Expand/collapse with chevrons; lazy nodes supported.

a11y: Tree role with levels and expanded states.
Arrows navigate; right expands, left collapses.

guidelines: Use the header for global identity, nav, search, and account.
Keep global actions few and predictable.
Header stays put while content scrolls.

specs.variants: With navigation, global actions, side nav toggle
specs.sizes: Fixed 48px height; full width
specs.notes: Pairs with left and right panels.

a11y: Banner landmark; skip-to-content is first.
Menu buttons expose expanded state.

guidelines: Use the left nav for primary product sections.
Group by task, not by team. Labels stay short.
Collapse on small screens; never hide current location.

specs.variants: Rail (icons), expanded, overlay on small screens
specs.sizes: 256px expanded; 48px rail
specs.notes: Selected item uses interactive highlight bar.

a11y: Nav landmark; current item uses aria-current.
Keyboard order matches visual order.

guidelines: Use the right panel for contextual detail, help, or notifications.
Open on demand; closing returns to the task.
Never put the only copy of critical state here.

specs.variants: Notifications panel, switcher panel, custom content
specs.sizes: 256px or 320px widths; overlays content
specs.notes: Header global actions toggle panels.

a11y: Panel labelled; Escape closes and returns focus.
Focus trapped only while modal behavior is required.
